description: This file defines the GroupCountBased class, which extends RegexBasedAbstract, and implements methods for processing regex-to-route mappings in a routing system, likely for HTTP request routing.

classes.name: GroupCountBased
classes.description: A class that generates route data based on group counts for pattern matching, part of the FastRoute routing library.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns the approximate size of chunks processed in route data generation.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a map of regex patterns to route information, generating a combined regex and route map for efficient matching.
